analysis.reasonEn: MACD histogram worsened from 4.0010 to -0.1656, indicating bearish convergence. RSI dropped from 65.1 to 49.2, returning to neutral territory. A Lower High pattern is confirmed as the 5-day high ($169.83) matches the 20-day high ($169.83). Volume ratio at 0.99 shows lack of momentum. Weekly RSI at 50.9 is neutral, and ADX at 16.3 suggests weak trend strength.
